text:
sam: quick check: thinking about adding an eviction handback safety checklist for prefix transfers so we avoid R/W skews.

anya: what are the must-haves?

sam: minimal list: 1) drain writes, 2) mark prefix as draining in metadata, 3) dual-read on miss until marker cleared, 4) reconciler sweep with repair, 5) metrics/alerts for hot flips.

lee: add one more: verify CAS on lease token before clearing marker. prevents race vs leader failover.

anya: agree. also prefer TTL on markers and exponential backoff on reconciler to avoid thundering herd for hot prefixes.

dev-bot: deploy-suggest: emit metrics -> ["prefix_drain_start","prefix_marker_set","prefix_marker_cleared","dual_read_proxy_count","handoff_reconciler_runs"]. alert on marker_set spikes. :bell:

sam: cool. i'll draft checklist + a tiny litmus test (write then handoff then read) and link in RFC. will ping for review.
